messages.content: "請先幫忙檢索大都會藝術博物館中排名前十的熱門藝術品，按照受歡迎程度排序，然後再檢索排名前五的藝術品，按照年代排序。之後，能否搜尋從2020年1月1日開始在加州提起的與Google有關的正在進行中的訴訟？最後，也能否找到從2018年1月1日開始在紐約提起的與Microsoft有關的已解決訴訟？"

function.name: metropolitan_museum_get_top_artworks
function.description: Fetches the list of popular artworks at the Metropolitan Museum of Art. Results can be sorted based on popularity. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

number.description: The number of artworks to fetch

sort_by.description: The criteria to sort the results on. Default is 'popularity'.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a specific company within a specific date range and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

company.description: The company related to the lawsuit.

start_date.description: Start of the date range for when the lawsuit was filed.

location.description: Location where the lawsuit was filed.

status.description: The status of the lawsuit. Default is 'ongoing'.

message.reasoning:
The user wants:

1. Retrieve top 10 popular artworks from Metropolitan Museum of Art, sorted by popularity.
2. Retrieve top 5 artworks sorted by chronological (i.e., by year). They say "排名前五的藝術品，按照年代排序" - maybe they want top 5 by popularity but sorted by chronological? Actually they said "then retrieve top five artworks sorted by chronological". So we need to fetch top 5 artworks sorted by chronological. But the function metropolitan_museum_get_top_artworks accepts number and sort_by. So we can call with number=10, sort_by='popularity' for first. Then call with number=5, sort_by='chronological' for second.

3. Search lawsuits related to Google, filed from 2020-01-01, location California, status ongoing. Use lawsuit_search with company="Google", start_date="2020-01-01", location="California", status="ongoing".

4. Search lawsuits related to Microsoft, filed from 2018-01-01, location New York, status settled. Use lawsuit_search with company="Microsoft", start_date="2018-01-01", location="New York", status="settled".

We need to call the functions accordingly. We'll produce calls in order. Probably we should call each function separately. The user wants all results. We'll call the functions sequentially. We'll output the results. We'll use the function calls.
